.premium-popup{
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);
    display:none;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding:15px;
    z-index:99999;
}

.premium-popup.active{
    display:flex;
}

.premium-popup-box{
    width:100%;
    max-width:420px;
    background:#fc9;
    border:3px solid #ff0016;
    border-radius:12px;
    overflow:hidden;
    position:relative;
    box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
    font-style: normal;
}

.popup-title{
    background:#ff0016;
    color:#fff;
    text-align:center;
    font-size:18px;
    font-weight:700;
    padding:12px;
}

.popup-close{
    position:absolute;
    right:10px;
    top:8px;
    border:0;
    background:none;
    color:#fff;
    font-size:28px;
    cursor:pointer;
    line-height:1;
}

.popup-menu{
    padding:10px;
}

.popup-item{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:12px;
    text-align:left;
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:12px;
    margin-bottom:10px;
    text-decoration:none;
    color:#222;
    border-left:4px solid #ff0016;
}
.popup-item strong{
    display:block;
    font-size:16px;
    font-weight:700;
    line-height:1.2;
}

.popup-item small{
    display:block;
    font-size:13px;
    color:#555;
    font-style:normal; /* ensure no italic */
    margin-top:2px;
}

.popup-icon{
    width:32px;
    text-align:center;
    font-size:22px;
    flex-shrink:0;
}

.popup-item span:last-child{
    margin-left:auto;
    font-size:18px;
    color:#999;
}

.popup-icon{
    font-size:24px;
}

.kalyan-notice {
    background: #fff8e1;
    border: 1px solid #f0c36d;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-radius: 6px;
}

.notice-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #7a4b00;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.notice-text {
    color: #222222;
}

.notice-text small {
    color: #333333;
}

.notice-text b,
.notice-text strong {
    color: #111111;
}

@keyframes glow{
    from{
        box-shadow:0 8px 15px rgba(255,87,34,.25);
    }
    to{
        box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(255,193,7,.65);
    }
}

@media(max-width:768px){
    .kalyan-notice{
        flex-direction:column;
        text-align:center;
        padding:14px;
    }

    .notice-text{
        font-size:18px;
    }
}
